title: Verb, い, な or Noun? Word Classes
description: The root of most mix-ups: which word class is it? Many differ from English and German (好き, 疲れる, 違う).

points.title: な-adjectives
points.summary: Stay the same and add だ / じゃない; な before a noun: 好きな人.
points.body:
**Verb, い-adjective, な-adjective, noun — side by side**

| | verb 書く | い-adj. 高い | な-adj. 静か | noun 学生 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| present | 書く / 書きます | 高い / 高いです | 静かだ / 静かです | 学生だ / 学生です |
| not | 書かない | 高**くない** | 静か**じゃない** | 学生じゃない |
| past | 書いた | 高**かった** | 静か**だった** | 学生だった |
| polite past | 書きました | 高かったです | 静かでした | 学生でした |
| before a noun | 書く人 | 高い本 | 静か**な**部屋 | 学生**の**時 |
| … and … | 書いて | 高**くて** | 静か**で** | 学生で |
| become | 書けるようになる | 高**く**なる | 静か**に**なる | 学生になる |

- **い-adjectives behave like verbs:** the word itself changes (高い → 高くない → 高かった). です only adds politeness: 高かったです, never 高いでした.
- **な-adjectives behave like nouns:** the word stays, だ / です / じゃない / だった do the work. The only difference: な before a noun (静かな部屋) where a noun takes の (学生の時).
- **Verbs have their own endings** (ない, ます, た) and never take です directly.

**Watch out for words whose class differs from English or German**
- English/German verb → Japanese adjective: 好き (like), 嫌い (hate), 欲しい (want), 上手・得意 (be good at), 怖い (be scared), 痛い (hurt).
- English/German adjective → Japanese verb: 疲れている (tired), 混んでいる (crowded), 結婚している (married), 違う (different).

points.title: Nouns
points.summary: Like な-adjectives, but の before a noun: 病気の人, 休みの日.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{好|す}き**?
questions.explanation: {好|す}き is a な-adjective: 好きじゃない, 好きだった, 好きな + noun. English 'like' is a verb, but 好き is a な-adjective: 猫**が**好きです.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{分|わ}かる**?
questions.explanation: {分|わ}かる is a verb: 分からない, 分かります, 分かった. German can say 'das ist mir klar' (an adjective), but Japanese only has the verb 分かる; what you understand takes が.
notes: An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{欲|ほ}しい**?
questions.explanation: {欲|ほ}しい is an い-adjective: 欲しくない, 欲しかった. 'Want' is a verb in English, but 欲しい (want a thing) is an い-adjective; the thing takes が: 車が欲しい.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{疲|つか}れる**?
questions.explanation: {疲|つか}れる is a verb: 疲れない, 疲れます, 疲れた. 'tired' is an adjective in English, but Japanese uses this verb: 疲れた / 疲れている (I'm tired).
notes: An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{眠|ねむ}い**?
questions.explanation: {眠|ねむ}い is an い-adjective: 眠くない, 眠かった. Here English and Japanese agree: 'sleepy' is an adjective. 'To sleep' is the verb 寝る / 眠る.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{上手|じょうず}**?
questions.explanation: {上手|じょうず} is a な-adjective: 上手じゃない, 上手だった, 上手な + noun. 'be good at' — 上手 is a な-adjective: 料理**が**上手です.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{元気|げんき}**?
questions.explanation: {元気|げんき} is a な-adjective: 元気じゃない, 元気だった, 元気な + noun.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{病気|びょうき}**?
questions.explanation: {病気|びょうき} is a noun: 病気じゃない, 病気の人 (with の, not な). 元気 is a な-adjective, but 病気 is a noun: 元気な人 vs 病気の人.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{静|しず}か**?
questions.explanation: {静|しず}か is a な-adjective: 静かじゃない, 静かだった, 静かな + noun.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{寒|さむ}い**?
questions.explanation: {寒|さむ}い is an い-adjective: 寒くない, 寒かった.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{嫌|きら}い**?
questions.explanation: {嫌|きら}い is a な-adjective: 嫌いじゃない, 嫌いだった, 嫌いな + noun. It ends in い, but the い is part of the word: 嫌いじゃない (not 嫌くない).
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{違|ちが}う**?
questions.explanation: {違|ちが}う is a verb: 違わない, 違います, 違った. 'Different' and 'wrong' are adjectives in English, but 違う is a verb: 違います, 違わない.
notes: An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **きれい**?
questions.explanation: きれい is a な-adjective: きれいじゃない, きれいだった, きれいな + noun. It ends in い, but the い is part of the word: きれいじゃない (not きれくない).
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{困|こま}る**?
questions.explanation: {困|こま}る is a verb: 困らない, 困ります, 困った. 'that's a problem / I'm in trouble' is a verb: 困ります, 困った.
notes: An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.
questions.translation: 困る = to be in trouble

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{怖|こわ}い**?
questions.explanation: {怖|こわ}い is an い-adjective: 怖くない, 怖かった. 'be scared' is an い-adjective: 犬が怖い, 怖かった.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{休|やす}み**?
questions.explanation: {休|やす}み is a noun: 休みじゃない, 休みの日 (with の, not な). 'off / free (today)' is a noun: 明日は休みです, 休みの日.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{暇|ひま}**?
questions.explanation: {暇|ひま} is a な-adjective: 暇じゃない, 暇だった, 暇な + noun. 'free (have time)' is a な-adjective: 暇な日, 暇じゃない.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{混|こ}む**?
questions.explanation: {混|こ}む is a verb: 混まない, 混みます, 混んだ. 'crowded' is a verb: 混んでいる (has got crowded).
notes: An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{有名|ゆうめい}**?
questions.explanation: {有名|ゆうめい} is a な-adjective: 有名じゃない, 有名だった, 有名な + noun. It ends in an い sound, but it's a な-adjective: 有名な店.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{痛|いた}い**?
questions.explanation: {痛|いた}い is an い-adjective: 痛くない, 痛かった. 'hurt' is a verb in English (wehtun), but 痛い is an い-adjective: 頭が痛い.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.
A noun takes の before another noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{学生|がくせい}**?
questions.explanation: {学生|がくせい} is a noun: 学生じゃない, 学生の時 (with の, not な).
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A な-adjective would add じゃない and take な before a noun.

questions.prompt: Which word class is **{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}**?
questions.explanation: {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ} is a な-adjective: 大丈夫じゃない, 大丈夫だった, 大丈夫な + noun. 'all right' — a な-adjective: 大丈夫じゃない.
notes: A verb would have ない / ます / た forms of its own.
An い-adjective would change its い (…くない, …かった).
A noun takes の before another noun.
